name: Shikigi Lyla
source:
"What's wrong, Yuuri? Have you finished work already?"

She is the chancellor of Nijou Crane Academy in addition to being the [url=/c113636]sensei[/url]'s aunt and [url=/c113642]Kiki[/url]'s mother. She is very important and has taken in Yuuri, who was unemployed, as a temporary teacher to the academy. 
......Why is the chancellor so important? In the first place, what kind of work does she usually do? Most people probably think of her as someone who comes to the school once in a while and gives a long talk at the morning assembly. Or perhaps, her perception as a "suspicious" person is more important. 
Her age is unknown. She has exceptional good looks and always has a suspicious smile on her face. 
This new sensei she brought with her also has a reputation for frequently disappearing somewhere. It is very suspicious. Maybe since he is her nephew, he knows something about her?
[i]"Ever since I was a kid, she would come by my house and suddenly leave on rare occasion. I only found out about her profession when she hired me. She is a very secretive and suspicious person"[/i]
Is that something to say about someone's benefactor who saved him from unemployment?
If that's the case, she is definitely suspicious.

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]

Height: 175 cm
